The '''Rendili system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], which was the home of [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] and the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]].
